details.s: Denethor II was the twenty-sixth and last Ruling Steward, also last overall Steward, of Gondor. He was father to War of the Ring heroes Boromir, a member of the Fellowship of the Ring, and Faramir, Captain of the Rangers of Ithilien.
f: Ruling Steward of Gondor, Lord of Gondor, Lord of Minas Tirith
